subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should OpenClaw prefer this PR's stale-internal-drop strategy, the preserve-as-context strategy in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759, or a combined narrower repair before either branch merges?
rationale: Both open PRs target the same stale orphaned-user-message problem but intentionally change prompt/session-state semantics in different ways; green helper tests cannot decide which runtime contract maintainers want.

options.title: Pick one canonical strategy first
options.body: Pause both candidates until maintainers choose the session-state semantics, then require proof on the selected branch before merge.

options.title: Land this drop strategy
options.body: Proceed with this PR only after redacted embedded-agent proof shows all six internal handoffs drop stale text and `sessions_send` still preserves user-directed input.

options.title: Favor preserve-as-context
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 as the canonical path and close this PR only after maintainers accept that it covers this stale-internal case well enough.

recommendation.title: Pick one canonical strategy first
recommendation.body: Pause both candidates until maintainers choose the session-state semantics, then require proof on the selected branch before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is closest to the queued-user prompt preservation invariant introduced and merged in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/65478.
